title: How to Choose Avocado Cream: What to Look For on the Label
ex: A simple step-by-step guide to reading an avocado cream label, matching texture to your skin, and checking jar size and value.
rt: How to Choose Avocado Cream: Label Checklist | Mirc Glow
rd: How to choose avocado cream: what to look for on the label, from ingredient order to jar size, texture and price per gram, for every skin type in India.
keyword: how to choose avocado cream / what to look for on the label
quick: Start with the ingredient list: avocado (Persea gratissima or Persea americana) should be easy to find, with supporting ingredients that suit your skin. Then match the texture to your skin type, check for a sealed jar and expiry date, and compare price per gram.
facts: Ingredients are listed from most to least.
Avocado appears as Persea gratissima oil or Persea americana extract.
Kojic acid is usually used at about 1–2% and needs daily sunscreen.
A 10 g jar suits testing; 25–30 g suits regular use.
